investigation_of_newcombe_discrepancy.core_mechanism: Newcombe Method 10 inverts the uncorrected asymptotic McNemar chi-square test (X^2 = (b-c)^2 / (b+c) = 25/7 = 3.5714, p = 0.05877), not the exact binomial test (p = 0.1250). Positive correlation phi = 0.458349 reduces the combined margin of error to 0.2011, placing the lower bound at +0.0072.
investigation_of_newcombe_discrepancy.resolution: When continuity correction is applied (Newcombe Method 11 or CC-Wald), the interval widens to [-3.45%, +42.48%] or [-3.27%, +36.60%], properly spanning zero and aligning with the exact McNemar test p = 0.1250.
